[[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] '''Torken''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Imperial soldier]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], he was stationed on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. One of the primary lightning spires supplying [[Kaas City]] with power was raided and sabotaged by rebelling [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] and so he asked a traveler to deal with the rebellious slaves and recover the components.
